test_masked_reductions_sum: test the masked_reductions.sum function to compute sum of a numpy array while skipping NA values using a boolean mask
test_masked_reductions_minmax: test the masked_reductions.min and masked_reductions.max functions to find minimum and maximum values in a masked numpy array
test_masked_reductions_mean: test the masked_reductions.mean function to compute the mean of a numpy array ignoring masked NA values along a given axis
test_masked_reductions_var_std: test the masked_reductions.var and masked_reductions.std functions to compute variance and standard deviation of a masked numpy array
test_masked_reductions_prod: test the masked_reductions.prod function to compute the product of a numpy array while handling missing values via a boolean mask
